info.description: Source-derived HTTP contract. Authorization intersects credential abilities with live instance/project membership. Unknown/global scopes require instance permission; roles do not grant access to unrelated projects. Schemas describe JSON representation, not every semantic validation. Extension x-schema-inference lists expressions whose exact shape cannot be inferred; these are deliberately not presented as typed SDK guarantees.
